title: Pricing Harness — Scenario Compare Result
description: Output of the Scenario Compare orchestration layer (docs/features/scenario_compare/SPEC.md). Every per-scenario mode result is the UNMODIFIED output of run_mode_a/run_mode_b/run_mode_c/run_bep on that scenario's derived client_input — reused here via $ref into analysis_result.schema.json's existing mode_a_block/mode_b_block/mode_c_block/bep_block definitions, not redefined. Scenario Compare introduces no new calculation semantics; this schema only arranges existing mode outputs plus a small set of pass-through summary/delta views.

status.description: SPEC.md section 9's canonical rollup, applied once more across all scenarios' own scenario_status values: ERROR > INCOMPLETE > OK.

baseline_scenario_id.description: Echoed from the request, so this result document is self-contained.

warnings.description: scenario_compare-level conditions that don't belong to any single scenario. Two distinct cases populate this array: (1) STEP 1 request-level preflight failures (SPEC.md section 15) — duplicate scenario_id, missing/unresolvable baseline_scenario_id, base_input id-uniqueness failures, unresolvable override targets, disallowed override fields; when these are present, status=ERROR and scenarios is empty, the whole request failed before any scenario was built. (2) BASELINE_SCENARIO_INVALID_FOR_DELTA (SPEC.md section 14a) — present exactly once (never duplicated per sibling scenario) when the baseline scenario itself failed STEP 3; scenarios is NOT empty in this case, every other scenario's absolute results/summary are still present, only their deltas are affected. Scenario-level issues (a non-baseline scenario's own STEP 3 failure, or a mode's own warnings) live inside that scenario's own warnings instead, never here.

scenario_status.description: SPEC.md section 9: ERROR if any of results.mode_a/mode_b/mode_c/bep is ERROR, or if this scenario failed STEP 3 (results absent below); INCOMPLETE if no ERROR but at least one module is INCOMPLETE; OK otherwise.

results.description: Present only if this scenario passed STEP 3 (its merged client_input validated against client_input.schema.json). Absent when scenario_status=ERROR due to a STEP 3 failure — no partial/best-effort mode results are fabricated for an invalid client_input.

summary.description: Present under the same condition as results (derived from it, read-only, no recomputation).

deltas.description: Present for every scenario including the baseline itself (SPEC.md section 14 — the baseline's own self-delta follows the same status-propagation rule as any other scenario's delta, never an unconditional 0/OK). Values are per-component-keyed, following whatever value/status the two operand metrics' own statuses produce — see component_delta.

warnings.description: Concatenation of every mode's own warnings (origin_module-tagged, SPEC.md section 11) plus, if this scenario failed STEP 3, a single scenario-local validation-failure warning; plus, on any OTHER scenario, a BASELINE_SCENARIO_INVALID_FOR_DELTA warning if the baseline itself failed STEP 3 (SPEC.md section 14a).

per_component.description: Keyed by component_id (never array index — SPEC.md section 15). Same component_id set as this scenario's client_input.product.price_components (structural overrides are unsupported in v0.1, so this set is identical across every scenario derived from the same base_input).

component_summary.description: Every field here is copied verbatim from that mode's own per_component metric objects (SPEC.md section 10) — no recomputation.

bep.description: null specifically when bep.status=ERROR with no per_component entry for this component_id (e.g. the multi-component gate, dependency_rules.md section 7) — distinct from a metric being individually UNKNOWN/ERROR, which is instead represented normally inside a present bep summary object.

component_delta.description: SPEC.md section 13/14: each field's value/status follows ERROR > UNKNOWN > NOT_APPLICABLE > OK propagation from its two source metrics (this scenario's own vs. the baseline's) — value is a plain number only when both are numeric OK, else null. Fixed source per field (section 14's table) — never a MODE B/C equivalent metric.

scenario_compare_warning.description: origin_module is the only field Scenario Compare adds; code/severity/metric_path/dependency_paths/message are copied verbatim from the source mode's own warning object when origin_module is mode_a/mode_b/mode_c/bep (SPEC.md section 11) — never reinterpreted. origin_module='scenario_compare' marks a warning Scenario Compare itself generates (request-level preflight failures, or BASELINE_SCENARIO_INVALID_FOR_DELTA), which does not correspond to any single mode's own output.
